p=base/'programs'/'task-0941976f.py'
p.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # The horizontal row of 1s is the base. Each embedded marker grows
    # a vertical stem upward: 2 has four cells above the base, 8 has three.
    base_row = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if any(v in (2, 8) for v in row))
    heights = {2: 4, 8: 3}
    for c, value in enumerate(grid[base_row]):
        if value in heights:
            height = heights[value]
            for offset in range(1, height + 1):
                r = base_row - offset
                if r < 0:
                    break
                out[r][c] = value if offset == height else 1
    return out
'''

# Reconstruct the three demonstrated base lines and expected stem cells, then verify program preserves all other cells.
def expected(grid, marker_heights):
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    br=next(i for i,row in enumerate(grid) if any(x in (2,8) for x in row))
    for c,h in marker_heights:
        for off in range(1,h+1): out[br-off][c]=grid[br][c] if off==h else 1
    return out
D1=[[0]*10 for _ in range(13)]; D1[9]=[1,1,2,1,1,1,8,1,1,1]
E1=expected(D1,[(2,4),(6,3)])
D2=[[0]*7 for _ in range(10)]; D2[5]=[1,1,1,2,1,1,1]
E2=expected(D2,[(3,4)])
D3=[[0]*6 for _ in range(9)]; D3[3]=[1,8,1,1,1,1]
E3=expected(D3,[(1,3)])
checks=[mod.transform(x)==y for x,y in [(D1,E1),(D2,E2),(D3,E3)]]
print(checks)
